plainText:
Carmen (Japanese: タナカ Tanaka) is a character from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet. She is a member of Team Star.

==In the core series games==
Carmen is a that appears in Caph Squad's Base. She is a close friend of Eri, and battles the to try and stop them from attacking the base. Due to being a named character, she uses the Trainer class instead of Team Star Grunt.

===Pokémon===
 
 
 
 
===Quotes===
Caph Squad's Base
Outside, before battle
"Riri! I knew you'd be out here!"
"Are you OK? You're not hurt, are you?!"
"I'll take over guarding the base, Riri! You should get back inside!"
"Oh, Riri! You need to stop this!"
"That's why you should get back to the base and rest up—even just for a little bit!"
"Riri, please! I'm your friend! Listen to what I'm saying!"
"Hey, that's no way to sign off! Let me hear a "hasta la vistar!" from you, nice and loud!"
"I'm your opponent now, you two! Come on—I'll take you both down!"
"I'll protect Riri with everything I have. You ready to battle?"
I'm so ready!: "Then here I come!"
Hold on!: "Just hurry up and leave, then! I'm not budging an inch from here."

Upon being defeated
"I lost...but my defeat's not the one that matters."

After being defeated
"Even if all I did was buy Riri a bit of time, that's fine. My job here is done, so I'll head back inside! Hasta la vistar! ☆"

Inside, after Eri is defeated
"Oh, Riri..."
"So, what did you want to ask me?"
"Oh, you spotted that? Well, all right... I don't mind telling you."
"Truth is, I used to hate Riri. She's an amazing Trainer and athlete—and she's really pretty, too. It took her no time at all to become popular at the academy. I was queen of the class before she came along, but then everyone liked her more than me..."
"Pretty much. I got our classmates to join in, too... We were all so stupid. But in the end, kids are always fickle—and once one thrill wears off, they look for something new. Before long, the class chose me as their next target and started bullying me instead. I guess I deserved it. But then Riri...she chose to help me even though I'd been so horrible to her. She told me that she understood how hard it is to have no one on your side... And she invited me into Team Star."
"She really is. And joining the team has worked out great for us. It's been so much fun!"
"After hearing my story, do you really think that's true?"
"Riri and the rest of Team Star made me who I am today. Please...don't take away our greatest treasure."

==In animation==
===Pokémon: Paldean Winds===
Carmen appeared in Take a Breath.

===Pokémon Adventures===
==== ====
Carmen debuted in the . She first appeared at the Caph Squad's Base, where she came across a stealing another 's Rotom Phone. She recognized the Tarountula as 's and examined the phone, which contained details on plans to launch a coup and take over Team Star. Carmen immediately tried to warn Eri, only to be intercepted by another Grunt and captured.

Later, Eri and a pair of Grunts snuck into the place where Carmen was held and freed her. Once Carmen explained why she was captured, everyone was approached by Scarlet, who was pretending to have been kidnapped in order to infiltrate the base. Scarlet had everyone look over the plans and Eri, wanting the best for all members of Team Star, came up with a plan to allow the coup to happen. In order for Eri's plan to work, Carmen allowed herself to stay captured but with the rope she was bound with loosened for her comfort.
